prior.national_baseline_citation: cdc_wonder D76 (Underlying Cause of Death, 1999-2020), Male 45-54 years, pooled 2015-2019: 514314 deaths / 104024440 person-years = 494.4 per 100k; pulled 2026-09-06 via scraper.cli wonder-mortality into warehouse wonder_mortality

method: Gamma-Poisson posterior per county; posterior_mean_rate = (prior_rate * prior_person_years + events) / (prior_person_years + person_years)
suppression: counties with <=9 deaths are absent from the export and therefore from this table; never reconstructed
